evidence/body.text: It occurs to me, another use of Arxana could be to help with Tufte style layouts — not necessarily with the pixel-by-pixel graphical aspects but with the inferential aspects.  So my MMCA / RRCA work for example uses pictures to scaffold the overall argument.  With an Arxana backing that could be made first class rather than implicit.
